core.title: Norton 7700 Series Top Jamb Mount Door Closer, NOR-7700

text.description_html:
Norton 7700 Series Door Closer

The Norton 7705 institutional door closer have fixed spring size 5 for interior doors up to 54" and exterior doors up to 48". They are narrow projection door controls: projection is just 2-1/8" from the surface of the door or the jamb.

Non-handed and have individual adjustments for sweep speed, latch speed, and backcheck cushioning. They come complete with a mounting plate for top jamb installations.

Features and Specifications of Norton 7500 Series Closer

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Cast Aluminum Body
  • Rack and Pinion Design
  • NorGlide Fluid
  • Maximum Door Size: 54" interior / 48" exterior
  • Maximum Door Weight: 250 lbs
  • Spring Tension: 6
  • Packed complete for top jamb mounting
  • Non Handed
  • UL 10C Compliant
  • Includes Slim Line Cover
  • Grade 1 Certified
  • 10 Year Limited Warranty
  • Norton 7500 Information Sheet (PDF)
